verdict_reason: Mack (1984) Fig 10.4 max FIRST-mode temporal omega_i vs R at M=10.0, adiabatic. The high-Mach first mode is OBLIQUE-dominated, so growth is maximized over BOTH alpha and wave angle psi (peak psi~54 deg, first-mode phase speed c_r~0.95, distinct from the 2D second mode c_r~0.9 of Fig 10.6). Domain-converged: y_max=150 ~4x delta*/L*=37.1 (a short box starves the thick BL and spuriously under-predicts the mode -- the Fig 10.6 domain lesson). pyMack omega_i,max(R) vs the digitized paper curve: median relative error 6.1% (mean 6.0%, max 8.8%) over 8 positive-growth overlapping R-stations (L* scale, 3D temporal first mode, N=200, y_max=150). A bounded residual offset above the 5% floor; the oblique first mode tracks Mack's rising-then-plateauing curve across the band.
